BEAR.desc: EPS -22.1%/yr (worst year FY12-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-1.8%/yr (FY22 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.2%/yr (FY12-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2022-02-11) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.32x (40.2% downside to Bear $40 / +124.3% upside to Bull $150) | Adj composite 3.50 vs market 1.72: gap +1.78 [UNDERVALUED] | +0% above the EPP floor $67 (19x FY22E $3.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: +48.8% total (+24.4%/yr) | At 19.0x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $88 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +10.9% in Q4 2021, forward revenues +1.3% (FY22 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
